title: Nodes don't update their order in live scene editing when being reordered with the keyboard in the Scene tree dock (as opposed to drag-and-drop)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.4.1.stable, 4.5.beta 037956dbc

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta (037956dbc) - Fedora Linux 42 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (nvidia; 575.64.03) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.33 GiB memory

### Issue description

> [!NOTE]
>
> This is all in the Local scene tree, so it's being updated with the live scene editing system, as opposed to the Remote scene tree. The Remote scene tree doesn't allow reordering nodes anyway.

When you reorder nodes in the Scene tree dock using <kbd>Ctrl + Up/Down Arrow</kbd>, it only works in the editor, not in the game view that is being live-edited. In contrast, it works if you use drag-and-drop with the mouse to reorder nodes.

This affects all uses of tree order in Godot, not just containers (I've also tested Sprite2Ds and their draw order being based on tree order).

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a579534d-a78b-4ec4-b3f3-5fe5e274a550

Compare this to the editor, where reordering nodes with the keyboard is working:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1cd30e1a-624f-4695-92a0-4e746f4bde84

### Steps to reproduce

- Run a project.
- Reorder nodes where it has a visible impact, e.g. in a Container or on overlapping Sprite2Ds.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test_live_edit_reorder_nodes.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21478639/test_live_edit_reorder_nodes.zip)
